label.purpose: Filters, dates, code, sources, and viewer state.

components.name: Tag Filter
components.description: Always-visible tag toggles with AND semantics.

components.name: Chart Entry
components.description: A short maidata code block with metadata, source, copy, and explicit load action.

components.name: Sticky Viewer
components.description: A fixed-in-viewport preview card that changes only on explicit load.

narrative.northStar: A quiet field notebook for chart configuration research.
narrative.overview: The page behaves like a personal technical blog: notes and filters occupy the scrollable left column, while the live MajdataView preview stays in a sticky right column. Thin rules, mono labels, graphite surfaces, mint actions, and amber BPM metadata establish a restrained geek-tool language.

rules.name: Explicit Load Rule
rules.body: Browsing, filtering, sorting, and scrolling never replace the current Viewer chart; only an article load action may do so.

rules.name: Source First Rule
rules.body: Show the actual maidata snippet and metadata before asking the user to preview it.

rules.name: Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Mint marks active and actionable states; amber marks BPM and source metadata; neither becomes a decorative background.

dos: Keep the Viewer visibly present beside the article stream.
Use AND wording whenever multiple tags are selected.
Keep loading and source links visually distinct.
donts: Do not turn the page into a generic card-grid landing page.
Do not reintroduce MP3, BG, track, or background-media controls.
Do not replace the native Viewer with a canvas approximation.
